'''Barbo's store''' was a mechanic shop in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] owned and run by [[Barbo]]. It was located just down the street from [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junk shop]].<ref name="Game" />
